physics_goals.quote: The analysis of KLOE data provided, and continues to provide, a variety of significant results on: neutral and charged kaon properties; tests of discrete symmetries; tests of the unitary of the quark mixing matrix
physics_goals.value: Kaon properties, tests of discrete symmetries and CKM unitarity, light scalar mesons, eta decays, hadronic cross sections and the muon anomaly, and dark-photon searches

summary.plain: An experiment at Frascati's DAΦNE phi factory that took data from about 1999 to 2006. Its 4-metre drift chamber and lead-fibre calorimeter recorded phi-meson decays, giving results on kaon properties, hadronic cross sections and the muon's magnetic moment. With its successor KLOE-2 it recorded around 8 inverse femtobarns.
summary.technical: KLOE at DAΦNE (√s = 1.02 GeV): 4 m-diameter drift chamber inside a lead-scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter; first data 1999 (CERN Courier) or 2000 (LNF), end 2006; physics on neutral and charged kaon properties, discrete-symmetry tests, CKM unitarity, light-scalar spectroscopy, η decays, hadronic cross sections and the muon g-2, dark-photon searches. Succeeded by KLOE-2.
